svg.title: Three ways to run watsonx.data integration
svg.desc: Three ways to run watsonx.data integration: a free 30-day trial to explore the full set of capabilities; SaaS, fully managed, on IBM Cloud and AWS; software, self-managed on IBM Software Hub, by subscription or perpetual license. IBM measures both SaaS and software in Resource Units.
